newsitem.title: USA: Qwest Communications issues $250 mln 10-yr debt.
newsitem.headline: Qwest Communications issues $250 mln 10-yr debt.

text.p: The following debt issue from Qwest Communications International Inc was priced in the 144A private placement market on Tuesday, according to a high-yield market source.
The deal was restructured to raise the senior note offering by $50 million and eliminate a planned $250 million tranche of zero-coupon notes, the source said.
The company is in the process of building a national fiber-optic telecommunications network.
Salomon Brothers was lead manager on the deal.
